verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an AI assistant, so the axis applies, but no evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest items are adjacent features that earn no credit: "ChatGPT data controls" applying to processed content (without saying what they control), memory scoping via /memories, and admin access controls. The Profile activity-insights feature, if anything, suggests usage is tracked rather than offering an opt-out.
